The Time when the covering configuration holds, and the Subregion of the Location that is involved may, optionally, be indicated.    'By Summer, weeds dotted the field .' Prepositional and verb targets of this frame differ in the ways they can participate in forming sentences; one of the most important differences is that prepositions may modify the entire sentence to describe the event (the Theme) as distributed over the Location. Generally, this implies that the Entity is not deeply or permanently physically affected, nor is it overall moved from one place to another.  'Ian squeezed Mara's hand.'
